name: Honda XR650L
engine: 644 cc air/oil-cooled SOHC single, one carb
intro: A simple, tough big single. Keep the valves adjusted and expect to fix the lean stock jetting.

add.title: Check valve clearances
add.instructions: Set the valves to spec with the engine cold. The screw adjusters are easy to reach.
add.reason: Valves that drift out of clearance cause stalling and long-term damage.

G: The stock carb runs lean. Backfiring on decel and poor throttle response usually mean it needs re-jetting.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Valves and stalling
known.what: Valves fall out of clearance and cause stalling. A failing pulse generator can too.
